title: VICTORIAN PART COFFEE SET WITH...
reason: Large dated (about 1888) Victorian Imari-style coffee set of about 36 pieces in bright condition; maker unmarked.
findings: Victorian coffee set in an Imari-style palette: underglaze blue panels with orange-red enamel flowers and gilt, alternating with white panels with blue star flowers, gilt rims. Counted from the photos: about 11 or 12 coffee cans, about 12 saucers, about 10 side plates and 2 large plates (about 25 cm), roughly 36 pieces in all. The base of a plate carries a printed blue 'Rd No 95917' registered design mark, and the base of a can shows a small blue rectangular printed mark whose text is illegible. 95917 falls in the 1888 range of the UK registered design sequence (1888 starts at 90483), so the set dates from about 1888. No maker's name or backstamp seen, so the maker is not identified (a web search for the number found nothing). Title (Victorian, part coffee set, Imari decoration) is supported.
condition: Gilding and enamel look bright with little wear; no chips or cracks visible; handles on the standing cans intact. The lying cans and stacked pieces are not checked all round.
rescore_note: Large, bright Victorian Imari-style coffee set of about 36 pieces dated to about 1888 by its Rd No, but the maker is unmarked, the body looks like earthenware, and Victorian sets sell modestly; my estimate is $100 to $180.
